description: S457 4a — an operator after a NON-handler unquoted value is refused: `title=@msg + "x"` compiled to `title="msg"` plus a stray `x` attribute, at exit 0.
rationale: §5.2 "An unquoted value is read WHOLE": "any other attribute followed by an operator … is E-ATTR-UNQUOTED-OPERATOR" (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S457 "1a 2a 3a 4a 5 dd it 6a", item 4 — "never silently truncated").
